claims.subject: flow_002_fetch_i_drvFTop
claims.explanation: The flow starts at the module boundary with i_drvFTop, passes through a pmtLock_top fifo, then a cfifo7 fifo, then a spliter5 that forks the event into two paths. One path goes to mergeInt (which also receives events from another flow via w_spliter2Drv2MergeInt) to produce o_drv2Int. The other path goes to merge1, then through two delay stages (delayfifo8, delayfifo8_2), a fifo (cfifo8_saveMerge1Data), another fifo (cfifo8), then a select5 that forks again: one branch goes through cfifo_lock to o_drv2ICache, the other goes to a delay1 (not shown as endpoint). This is a single-drive flow because it originates from one input event and fans out through deterministic branching points.
